explication: Earthly is a container-based CI/CD build system: users invoke the CLI on Earthfiles, which describe reusable build targets; Earthly resolves inputs and dependencies, translates commands into BuildKit build states, executes the resulting graph, then exports images or artifacts. The graph also shows parsing, variable handling, build-context resolution, caching, progress reporting, and debugging as distinct capabilities. Most implementation links beyond the sampled excerpts are documented at the product level; those edges cite the README rather than implying unsampled call sites were inspected.
